name: python-version-vectors
title: Version Vectors
blurb: Causal order as a partial order you can compare: one counter per writer, four verdicts (equal, before, after, concurrent), a merge that is a join, causal delivery that holds a message until its dependencies arrive, and compaction measured for where it is exact and where it silently changes the answer.
default_description: Version vectors with concurrency detection, causal delivery, and compaction measured against a floor.
